newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the Panhandle area late Thursday. Limited test of slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 lower.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 700 slaughter steers and 1,700 heifers; 91,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 head CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,000 head formulated and 800 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Wk to date: 91,200 Week Ago: 101,600 Year Ago: 103,700
